# Nimbuz CLI (@nimbuz-tech/cli)

> Official command-line interface for Nimbuz Cloud, a PaaS organised as projects → environments → apps and managed tools (databases, services). Binary name: `nimbuz`. Install: `npm i -g @nimbuz-tech/cli` (Node.js >= 18, zero runtime dependencies). API base: https://api.nimbuz.tech.

Key facts for agents:

- Non-interactive use: set `NIMBUZ_TOKEN` (or `echo "$PASS" | nimbuz login --org <org> -u <user> --password-stdin`), and pass `--json --yes` to every command.
- `--json` writes a JSON document to stdout; progress/spinners go to stderr. `-q/--quiet` prints only names/IDs, one per line.
- Scope: `-p/--project <name|id>` and `-E/--env <name|id>`, or env vars `NIMBUZ_PROJECT` / `NIMBUZ_ENV`, or saved context from `nimbuz use <project> [env]`. Names match case-insensitively or by unique prefix.
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error, 4 not logged in / session expired, 5 not found, 130 cancelled.
- Destructive commands (delete, stop, revoke…) require `--yes` when there is no TTY.
- Deploy flow: `nimbuz init` writes `nimbuz.json`; `nimbuz deploy` creates-or-updates the app and waits until live. `${VAR}` / `${VAR:-default}` in the manifest are read from the environment.
- Config: `~/.nimbuz-cli/config.json` (override with `NIMBUZ_CONFIG_DIR`); multiple accounts via `--profile <name>`.

- [README](https://github.com/nimbuz-tech/nimbuz-cli/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, quick start, manifest, CI usage

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nimbuz-tech/nimbuz-cli/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guide for AI agents using or modifying the CLI

## Core command groups

Hierarchy: Project → Environment → Apps and Tools.


- `login`, `logout`, `whoami`, `use`, `context`, `status`, `init`, `deploy`: getting started
- `projects`: list/get/create/update/delete projects (a project groups environments)
- `envs`: list/get/create/update/delete environments, set CPU/memory/storage limits, `envs usage` for quota
- `apps`: create from Git or archive, update/scale, redeploy, start/stop/restart, status --watch, releases, `apps env` and `apps secrets`
- `tools`: browse `tools catalog`, install/update/resize/start/stop/delete managed PostgreSQL, MongoDB, n8n and more; `tools get` shows connection details
- Also: `domains`, `ai`, `logs`, `metrics`, `billing`, `team`, `support`, `auth`, `config`
